about.title: About us
about.whoBody: With over a decade of experience in the industry, Klüg Hydraulics is a company specialized in the manufacture and distribution of high-performance hydraulic components. With engineering inspired by German precision, we design smart, reliable and efficient solutions for diverse industries, including construction, industrial automation, agriculture and transportation.
about.missionBody: At KLÜG, we engineer innovative hydraulic solutions that enhance performance, minimize downtime, and drive sustainability. Through precision engineering, robust quality control, and a commitment to customer success, we deliver products that power industries with efficiency and reliability.
about.visionBody: To revolutionize the hydraulics industry by creating efficient, innovative and sustainable components that drive the future of automation and industrial development globally.
about.whyBody: From precision valves to energy-efficient hydraulic systems, our products deliver superior performance, durability, and cost-effectiveness.

precision.title: Precision Engineering
precision.body: We base our designs on German standards, guaranteeing maximum performance and reliability.

innovation.title: Innovation and Agility
innovation.body: We adapt quickly to market needs, introducing new technologies and efficient solutions.

personalized.title: Personalized Approach
personalized.body: Unlike the giants in the industry, we design solutions tailored to the specific needs of each customer.

sustainability.title: Commitment to Sustainability
sustainability.body: We develop energy-efficient components aligned with Industry 4.0 trends.

quality.title: Quality – Price Ratio
quality.body: We offer high performance products without the cost overruns of the big brands.

about.joinBody: We have a team of highly trained professionals committed to excellence. Our organizational culture fosters continuous development and collaboration, allowing us to adapt to market challenges and exceed our clients' expectations.

smart.title: Smart Hydraulics & IoT

energy.title: Energy-Efficient Systems

global.title: Global Expansion
global.body: Expanding in regions with industrial growth could provide new revenue streams.
